subject: Request: Quarterly installment billing + Net-90 term for Cirrus HealthTech
messages:
From: Tara Patel <tara@cirrushealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cirrushealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: quarterly/installment billing and Net-90 term

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the great demo last week. Our procurement team has a hard fiscal calendar and needs the initial invoice to be split across the next four quarterly payments. Additionally, their standard payment terms are Net-90 (they can only pay on the next quarter after invoice date).

Attached is the PO form they're asking us to accept. Can Redwood accommodate quarterly installments and Net-90 for the first year? We expect a 12-month commitment and would like this in writing to move forward with signature.

If there are fees or an alternative that would speed approval, please let me know — procurement is timeboxed this month.

Appreciate the help,

--
Tara Patel
Head of Procurement
Cirrus HealthTech
T: 415-555-0182
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Tara Patel <tara@cirrushealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: quarterly/installment billing and Net-90 term

Tara —

Thanks for the note and the PO form. We normally operate on Net-30 with monthly invoices. Two options we can propose quickly:

- Quarterly invoicing + Net-60 (preferred compromise)
- Quarterly invoicing + Net-90 as a one-time exception with an added 2% processing fee or prepayment of first quarter

I've looped in Marcus from Finance to comment on cashflow implications and Laura from Deal Desk to flag any contract/terms concerns. I attached a short invoice plan that maps how invoices would be issued under the two options.

Goal: get alignment this week so legal can proceed to finalize the SOW and we can route for signature. If Cirrus can confirm willingness to accept the 2% processing fee for Net-90, that will materially help approvals.

Best,

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc:
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: quarterly/installment billing and Net-90 term

Stephanie/Laura —

From a finance perspective, Net-90 across quarterly invoices increases our DSO exposure significantly for a mid-six-figure ARR deal. If we accept Net-90 without mitigations, we should either require:

1) A 5% surcharge to offset carrying cost, or
2) Receipt of the first quarter as prepayment, or
3) An approved credit hold with explicit escalation for late collections.

I ran a quick simulation and attached a cashflow impact sheet showing scenarios with 2% and 5% fees and the prepayment option. If the customer is firm on Net-90, my preference is the prepayment for the first quarter + Net-60 thereafter.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: quarterly/installment billing and Net-90 term

Team —

Deal Desk notes: we can grant a billing cadence exception, but Net-90 is an out-of-policy term and needs VP-level sign-off. Conditions we should attach if we approve:

- Minimum 12-month committed term (signed SOW)
- 2% processing fee applied to invoices issued with Net-90, or first-quarter prepayment
- Finance to own collections cadence and an agreed escalation path if invoices age >120 days
- Legal to confirm contract language aligns with PO and explicitly references exception

I am escalating to Rishi for final approval. If Rishi signs off on the 2% fee + monitoring, we can draft the exception memo and include it in the SOW.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Senior Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: Tara Patel <tara@cirrushealth.com>, procurement@cirrushealth.com
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: quarterly/installment billing and Net-90 term — APPROVED (conditional)

Team/Tara —

After reviewing the context and the cashflow impact, I approve a one-time billing exception: Cirrus may be billed quarterly on Net-90 for the first three quarters with the following conditions:

- 2% processing fee applied to invoices covered by Net-90
- First quarter must be pre-authorized on their PO/ACH or paid within 30 days of signing (we accept documented prepayment authorization)
- After the initial three quarters, terms will move to Net-60 for the remainder of the contract
- Finance will track collections weekly and trigger the escalation playbook at 90/120 days

Stephanie: please confirm Cirrus agrees to these conditions, get Legal to add the exception language to the SOW, and send the signed exception form back to finance. I've uploaded the signed approval form to the deal record and attached the approved-exception-form.pdf. DocuSign link for the SOW: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Sales Operations
